text:
Jordan (support): Heads-up: ACME's SIEM only got events up to 2024-11-10T03:12Z. Customer says forwarder returned 403 with 'hsm-auth:access_denied'. They want a replay for tenant acme-corp and clarity if retention purged data. @Sam @Priya

Sam (eng-security): on it. Can you paste the export manifest id and the raw error lines? Any replay attempts so far?

Jordan (support): Here's the minimal curl output we got from their SIEM connector:
```
$ curl -v https://export.redwood.ai/forwarder/acme/manifest-97b2.json
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< x-redwood-error: hsm-auth:access_denied
```
We tried a replay from our side and saw repeated KMS failures.

deploy-bot: deploy/audit-forwarder v3.9.1 -> prod at 2468001200 (ok) :white_check_mark:

Priya (infra): 403 from KMS/HSM usually means the forwarder role can't Decrypt with the key alias in the object metadata. Could be alias rotated or policy missing. Do you have the manifest path?

Jordan (support): manifest path: s3://redwood-exports/acme/2024-11-10/manifest-97b2.json
Replays attempted: `replay-tool --tenant acme-corp --start 2024-11-10T00:00 --end 2024-11-10T04:00` -> saw 'skipped: hsm decrypt failed' for ~8 shard objects.

Sam (eng-security): two likely causes: 1) HSM/KMS alias rotated and forwarder doesn't have new alias in IAM policy 2) retention TTL shortened and objects were purged. We need S3 object list + KMS metadata + forwarder policy.

Priya (infra): Quick repro checklist for infra: 1) aws s3 ls --recursive s3://redwood-exports/acme/2024-11-10/ --include "*shard*" 2) aws kms describe-key --key-id <alias> 3) aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-exports --key acme/2024-11-10/<shard> and inspect x-amz-meta-kms-keyid 4) verify role/audit-forwarder-prod has kms:Decrypt on that key. I can run 2–4 if you confirm manifest id.

Jordan (support): Confirming manifest-97b2.json. Customer also flagged billing spikes during initial replay attempts and paused them. They want ETA for redelivery vs manual replay.

Sam (eng-security): I'll escalate to infra for a re-encrypt-backfill path if keys rotated. If it's a retention purge, we need to explain data loss. Priya, can you check HSM logs for decrypt failures around 2024-11-10T03:00–03:20Z? @deploy-bot any config rollouts touching kms-alias in last 48h?

deploy-bot: config-rollout: audit-forwarder.kms_alias changed in staging only at 2467998000. Prod unchanged.

Priya (infra): I see ~8 'NotAuthorized' entries in HSM logs for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01 at 2024-11-10T03:10Z referencing principal role/audit-forwarder-prod. Opening secure ticket to update key policy and attach decrypt for that principal. ETA ~2h to patch policy and run a dry-run replay.

Jordan (support): Customer also asked about billing — they saw token/egress charges during their replay attempts and paused. Should we offer credits for the replay cost if this was a platform-side auth bug?

Sam (eng-security): Yes, offer one-time credits for replay token costs. I'll draft the support message and open a billing request to waive charges tied to failed replays caused by platform-side HSM/KMS auth.

Jordan (support): Thanks — I'll update ACME with 'we're attempting a re-encrypt/replay; ETA ~2h; we'll cover replay costs if it's our fault'. Tagging this thread for escalation.
